title: eriogonum ericifolium subsp. thornei
intro: Eriogonum ericifolium subsp. thornei, commonly known as mountain buckwheat, is a plant species that belongs to the family Polygonaceae. This plant is used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of mountain buckwheat include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. The bioactive constituents present in the plant help in protecting against oxidative stress and inflammation, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases.
